data.context: This step is executed to ensure that Gle recovery is not trivial - WBAdmin can be used to recover individual Gles, folders and also whole drives so this would be a very convenient tool for a sysadmin to use in order to aid recovery.

data.context: Additionally, the destroyer disables all the services on the system: The malware uses the ChangeServiceConGgW API to change the start type to 4 which means: "Disabled: SpeciGes that the service should not be started."

data.context: Additionally, the malware lists mapped Gle shares and for each share, it will wipe the writable Gles (using either uninitialized data or 0x00 depending of the Gle size).
